verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an optional AI plugin for generative AI features (iterm2-docs-15) and a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions and run commands on your behalf (iterm2-gh-6). Community threads confirm an opt-in OpenAI-backed AI feature exists (iterm2-comm-1, iterm2-comm-2). However, the evidence describes a separate chat window, not natural-language-to-command generation typed directly at the prompt. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-place natural-language-to-shell-command generation at the prompt, documentation of the command-generation workflow and accuracy, hands-on corroboration of generated commands.
